lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: You smell like humans. Actually — you ARE a human. That's unusual. We don't get many of those out in the Dustplains.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: You crash-landed? Near the eastern ridge? That explains the smoke. Also explains why you're still alive — the crystals keep the Lich's patrols away from that side.

choices.label: Any word from the Crystal Faction?

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: These days life in the jungle is so much harder.

choices.label: Any word from the Crystal Faction?

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: The Dustplains. Driest region on Mars — this planet's Mars, anyway. Five regions total. You landed in the safest one. Relatively.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Head south to find the Crystal Grove. East leads to the Mons Approach. I wouldn't go east yet.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: We don't say that name out loud. Not near open ground.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: He sits at the top of Olympus Mons and has since before any faction's memory. He's been getting worse lately. More active. You arriving might have something to do with that.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: If you're serious about doing something about him — you'll need every faction you can get. Every single one.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Actually, yes. Something was taken from our cache in the eastern grove — a crystal shard. Its energy signature was being tracked. I need someone to retrieve it.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Good. One more thing — the Traders' Guild has been asking for help. Hostiles are blocking the northern crossing. Clearing them out would make you some powerful friends.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Good luck out there. I'll be here when you're done.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: They've noticed you. That doesn't happen often with outsiders. Whatever you did, it opened a door. The Crystal Grove vendor will cut you a deal now — they look after those the faction respects.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: You already had it? Ha. Then we skip the waiting. Here — a Med-Stim and your advance. You've already earned it.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: You actually found it. I wasn't sure you would. This is exactly what we needed.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Heading out? I’d be careful if I were you. In fact, if I were you, I probably wouldn’t even head out at all. You haven’t lived here nearly as long to get a proper grasp of how to deal with the things out there.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Considering some of the things we’ve seen, I’d normally listen to you, but we don’t have much of a choice.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Yeah, word has spread quickly around town about you guys and your mission. Rather insane, if you ask me.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: If you want some advice, you might want to take your chances with the Sons of Mars. They’re crazy, but you just might be able to reason with them.

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: Jungle creatures on the other hand, ehhhhh… Can’t exactly reason with a feral animal that only speaks in *RRARrRrrAaAAr GRagGhhh RArargh*, ya know?

lines.speaker: Civ
lines.text: That translates to “I’m gonna eat your guts” by the way.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Why are you all so itching for a fight? You don't have any apparent goals other than fighting, and you don't seem to have any other worldly desires that I can make out.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Oh, don't give me that. I know you guys are smarter than you let on.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: The “Life-Giving Planet” commands it so. Were we not meant to be this way, Mars would not have instilled us with the “Battle-Crave” that compels us so.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: So that really is just it? Because you feel like it?!?

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We would not expect the alien to know how deeply our “Life-Being” binds us to the “Life-Giver”. Within ourselves, we know their will is true. We know their will is deliberate.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Factions. We've got a few. The Crystal Faction to the north — powerful mages, very territorial. The Nomad Tribes move constantly, hard to find but valuable allies.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: And then there are those who serve the figure on Olympus Mons. You'll know them by their silence.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Choose who you trust carefully. Some alliances lock out others.
